quote: Asking Clarification Questions (T2) by following two main routines: generation or selection from a pool of candidate clarification questions.

The generation route ... includes BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE ... these metrics have also been applied ... while addressing the ACQ task ... The existing approaches (e.g., Seq2Seq models) could be ... generate clarification questions.
The idea behind Conversational Question Answering (Conv. QA) is to ask the system a question about a provided passage offering a conversational interface.
On the other hand, some common metrics for the generation route include (8) BLEU, ( ) METEOR, (10) ROUGE. ... they have also been applied as evaluation metrics while addressing the ACQ task.
The widely-used metrics can be categorized into two groups based on the strategy of giving clarification questions, i.e., ranking or generation.

In addition to automatic evaluation metrics, human evaluation provides a more accurate and qualitative evaluation of generated or ranked CQs. ... The human annotation process consists of scoring generated or selected CQs based on several quality dimensions.
Thus, human annotations are increasingly used to evaluate clarifying questions.
